items.question: What is GORKA?
items.answer: GORKA is an AI-powered debt collection platform built for agencies and banks. It combines AI Copilot, multi-channel communications, and local-first data security to streamline collections.

items.question: Who is it built for?
items.answer: GORKA is built for debt collection agencies, banks, and financial institutions that need to manage debtor communications, track actions, and automate follow-ups.

items.question: How does data security work?
items.answer: GORKA uses a local-first architecture — your data stays on your own infrastructure. Nothing is uploaded to third-party servers unless you explicitly choose to use a cloud provider.

items.question: Can I import my existing data?
items.answer: Yes — GORKA supports CSV and Excel imports with dynamic column detection. No reformatting needed.

items.question: Do you offer a free trial?
items.answer: Yes — the Free tier includes basic AI tools and automation. Upgrade when you're ready to scale.

items.question: How is this different from legacy tools?
items.answer: GORKA automates what spreadsheets and legacy tools do manually — data organization, follow-ups, reporting — with AI assistance and local-first security.

items.question: What's your pricing model?
items.answer: We offer three tiers: Free, Professional, and Enterprise. All tiers include AI tools and automation. Enterprise includes custom solutions.
